name: MoYu AoLong 3x3 V5 (Magnetic, UV Coated)
description: The MoYu AoLong 3x3 V5 (Magnetic, UV Coated) is the same dual-axis, 48-magnet spring setup as the standard Magnetic — with a UV Coated finish for cubers who want extra grip and a glossy surface feel. Same tuning range, different texture under your fingers.
features: UV Coated finish: Super glossy plastic adds grip and a premium surface feel — a meaningful upgrade for cubers who find matte finishes too slick under pressure.
48-magnet system: Corner, edge, and core magnets provide consistent snap-to-alignment across every layer, every turn.
Carbon fiber core: Rigid and lightweight — keeps the structure stable without contributing unnecessary weight.
64 tuning combinations: 8 spring tension levels × 8 distance settings cover the full range from snappy competition feel to smooth, controlled turning.
Anti-corner-twist geometry: Outer right-angle corner design prevents twists under aggressive turning.
Dual adjustment system: Tension and distance are independently adjustable — change one without affecting the other.
